newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Barnes & Noble rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Barnes & Noble rated buy.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Dan Barry initiated coverage of Barnes & Noble Inc as a near- and long-term buy and set a 12-month price target of $49.
-- estimated earnings of $1.80 per share for 1997 and $2.25 for 1998 versus $1.48 for 1996.
-- said bookstore chain is "leading operator in fragmented industry with only one major competitor," Borders Group Inc .
-- sees superstore comparable store sales accelerating this year, getting boost from new point-of-sale system.
-- also cited presence on the Internet, where it is exclusive bookseller on America Online Inc. Bookseller will launch its own site on World Wide Web this spring.
